substantive_conclusions.architecture: C# owns typed application composition, finite static metadata, direct materializers and business code. Native SeaQuery/SQLx own query AST, dialect, relational execution, provider protocol/pools and runtime operations. Core remains a narrow BCL-facing lifecycle/ABI/error/buffer layer; no managed SQL engine, full IQueryable provider, global Rust runtime or ordinary per-entity Rust build is introduced.
substantive_conclusions.public_surface: The signature source,710 Database symbols,97 type policies and96 feature rows form a coherent minimum/advanced surface. Typed dynamic filters, aliases/joins, grouping/HAVING, nullable aggregates, projections, order/seek/page, prepared parameters, CTE/windows/set operations, CRUD/returning/upsert/bulk and explicit relations have defined defaults, ownership, errors, capability limits and costs.
substantive_conclusions.null_and_conversion: Native codec/configuration/nullability identity remains attached to tokens. Missing result shape is rejected before nullable decode; SQL NULL is separate from omission/default. Nonnullable-to-nullable lifts preserve SQL values; unsafe reverse projection is rejected. Scalar precision/UUID/text/JSON/enum/decimal/provider limitations are explicit and conversions are fallible.
substantive_conclusions.concurrency_and_transactions: Mutable builders are single-writer and arena-scoped; immutable prepared shapes use isolated execution parameters. Session single-command admission, savepoint LIFO, explicit expected-version CAS, caller-owned transactions, unknown commit and independent local cleanup are preserved. Disposal and cancellation do not prove remote rollback or native quiescence.
substantive_conclusions.ordinary_consumption: One provider facade supplies exact native/build-assets closure, natural source factories and default static Entity/DTO generation. The equivalent handwritten descriptor seam is explicit. Ordinary dotnet build/run/AOT publishing uses unchanged precompiled native assets without rd.xml, runtime expression compilation or a Rust toolchain invocation; current probes prove only their recorded finite mechanisms.
